profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Data Science, Spark, Infrastructure @ Microsoft
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer II at Microsoft, with a strong foundation in Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, and Data Engineering.

In my current role, I focus on enhancing the reliability, usability, and security of the distributed infrastructure behind Microsoft’s security products. I’ve optimized large Spark pipelines, fine-tuned underlying infrastructure, automated monitoring and alerting systems, built data visualizations, and implemented API improvements—all with the goal of improving both system performance and the customer experience.

One of my key accomplishments was optimizing five critical pipelines, reducing runtimes from over 10 hours to just 10 minutes. This work also brought Spark-related failures down to near zero, saving the company approximately $30K annually.

I’ve also collaborated closely with Applied Scientists to develop an LLM chatbot for Azure outage detection and partnered with product teams to leverage data engineering and visualization to drive actionable product insights.

Before joining Microsoft, I gained valuable experience as a Machine Learning Engineer at Hewlett Packard Enterprise, where I developed and tested a distributed hyperparameter tuning tool and demonstrated the ML capabilities of Cray’s supercomputer by implementing SVM in Chapel, a unique distributed language.

Outside of work, my background as a Division I student-athlete, mascot, and orientation leader has shaped my approach to collaboration and leadership. While balancing these extracurriculars, I completed two degrees (BA and MS) in Computer Science with a concentration in Data Science, graduating with distinction. These experiences have honed my resilience, efficiency, analytical mindset, and ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

I believe that with perseverance and determination, anything is possible. Let’s build a better future together!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Core member of datalake and data science team
•	Enhanced outage detection chatbot capabilities and developed a pipeline for evaluating LLM performance - presenting work a Microsoft's Machine Learning and Data Science Conference.
•	Optimize Spark pipelines through making changes to code and configurations, reducing runtimes by as much as 98%, yielding an average cost savings of $5k per year per optimized pipeline.
•	Develop robust telemetry system to understand data lineage of customer pipelines, allowing for removal of unused telemetry events (72% of total), with an estimated cost savings of ~$11k/month. 
•	Improve and automate data lake health monitoring dashboard and alerting system, proactively catching infrastructure/pipeline issues and reducing engineer hours spend monitoring cluster health by 90%. 
•	Planned migration of pipelines from Spark 2 to Spark 3, improving efficiency and reliability.
•	Coordinate and automate the migration of 650 Hive Tables to Synapse SQL, estimated savings of 4k/month
•	Improve team on-call function through taking initiative when customer-impacting issues arise, assisting on-call teammates, and writing clear, detailed, organized documentation for debugging infrastructure issues.
positions.insights: Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure Management and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer / Data Scientist
positions.description:
•	Led scoping, design, user input, and product development/deployment for Project Thundercats, an IntelliJ plugin for large query optimization – reducing operational costs.
•	Presented Thundercats Plugin at Microsoft CODE Conference.
•	Guided intern to implement recommender system for Thundercats Plugin, serving as project lead and mentor.
•	Engineered terabytes of raw data to create actionable visualizations around adoption, retention, and issue mitigation via Spark pipelines, visualizing the output in Power BI.
•	Championed responsible development and an inclusive workplace through presenting on Bias in Word Embeddings, Developing with Accessibility in Mind, and Native American History in Puget Sound.
positions.insights: Large Language Models (LLM), Microsoft Azure and +5 skills

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
•	Quantified and presented value of Hyperparameter Optimization tool (HPO), built for a National Lab, by developing Machine Learning pipelines to utilize the product and benchmark the improvements to metrics like MSE and RMSE by iteration for each algorithm.
•	Created proof of concept for Cray Graphics Engine (CGE) ML Capability by implementing Support Vector Machine (from scratch) to run in parallel as a user function.
•	Won 1st place in the intern “Best-in-Class” competition by presenting my work done on HPO.
